subject: [hw] T01 -> V15: T32 ADC/SBC use the shifter carry instead of the incoming C flag
body:
Differential harness found a real T32 DP bug in dp_shifted(): `unsigned carry = c->cf;` is then overwritten by `b = shift_imm_c(..., &carry);`, and the ADC/SBC cases pass that variable as cin. ADC/SBC must use the C flag as it was before the shift; only the shifter carry-out goes to *carry for logical ops. Repro (asmrun, current core):

  .syntax unified
  .thumb
  .text
  movs r0,#1
  movs r1,#0
  cmp r0,r0          @ C=1
  adc.w r2,r0,r1,lsl #1   @ e b40 0241; expected r2 = 1+0+1 = 2, got 1
  udf #254

Fix: take `unsigned cin = c->cf;` before the shift, and use `cin` in case 10/11 (`ADC`, `SBC`); keep the shifter `carry` only for the logical-case `c->cf = carry`. Same for the register-shifted form (dp_reg?) if it shares this code. Corpus effect: k_add64 thumb-O2/O3v seed 0 expected bc1a6901 got bc09f6b4; its disassembly contains `sbc.w r3,r0,r12,lsr #3` and `sbcs.w r1,r3,r0` (and ROR/IT forms which pass in isolation). No other T32 mismatch found yet.
